task.title: Phase L milestone L0 (awkit-djnl.2): owner audit and decision records
task.objective: Close Beads milestone awkit-djnl.2 after its deliverables land: the Phase L owner audit table in docs/plans/ai-upgrade-v5/ROADMAP.md and the decision record in docs/ai/DECISIONS.md, both verified against the code. Then refresh .beads/issues.jsonl with bd export -o so the Program Status dashboard sees the close. The lease exists only because bd writes require the project-state role; the documentation, plan corrections, the Phase L in-progress flip in src/roadmap/ImplementationRoadmap.ts and the dashboard verifier pins are ordinary unleased direct-loop edits made outside this lease.

acceptance.description: Milestone awkit-djnl.2 (L0) is closed with a reason naming its deliverables, and the ready set becomes the epic plus the four milestones L0 blocked: L1 awkit-djnl.1, L2 awkit-djnl.3, L4a awkit-djnl.5 and L5a awkit-djnl.7.

.beads/issues.jsonl is refreshed with bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl, and verify:roadmap-dashboard passes with the Overview banner reading Sources agree after its tracker pins move deliberately to the measured values.

evidence.command: bd close awkit-djnl.2 --reason ... then bd show awkit-djnl.2
evidence.observed: bd close printed 'Closed awkit-djnl.2 - L0: Phase L decisions and owner audit' with the deliverables as the reason. The first attempt was refused by the lease guard because the reason text contained a semicolon, which hasUnsafeShellSyntax treats as chaining even inside quotes (denial 1 of 3 for 'bd close'); the single retry without it succeeded.
Ready: 5 issues with no active blockers - the epic awkit-djnl plus awkit-djnl.1 (L1), awkit-djnl.3 (L2), awkit-djnl.5 (L4a) and awkit-djnl.7 (L5a), exactly the four milestones L0 blocked.
Printed 'Exported 302 issues to .beads/issues.jsonl'. bd stats then reported Total 302, Open 10, In Progress 0, Blocked 5, Closed 290, Ready 5.

After the tracker pin moved from 13/289 to 12/290 outstanding/closed (total 302 and 134 edges unchanged), the final-state run printed '177/177 roadmap dashboard checks passed', including '12 outstanding / 290 closed', '134 edges are present to classify', both narrative documents agreeing with the measured 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED tally, and 'the Overview banner reads "Sources agree"'. npm run build and verify:verifier-classification also passed on the final state.

completion.qa_basis: The bead close, ready set and export were inspected with bd close, bd ready and bd stats, and the final state passed npm run build, verify:verifier-classification (206/206 classified) and verify:roadmap-dashboard 177/177 with Sources agree. Every owner and field fact in the audit table and decision record was confirmed by reading the cited source before it was written.
completion.qa_known_limitations: Edits outside this contract's project-state routing were made unleased, as CLAUDE.md permits for ordinary non-Risk-3 work, and are disclosed rather than hidden: src/roadmap/ImplementationRoadmap.ts (Phase L set in-progress) and scripts/verify-roadmap-dashboard.mjs (tracker pin moved to measured values). node tools/agents/task-gate.mjs therefore reports canComplete false with 5 derived scope escapes, all traceable to those two files (the qa and software ownership domains, the implied general_engineering_change flag, and the two paths), which is why completion.status is implemented rather than complete. Several decision values are agent-chosen defaults marked as such in DECISIONS.md and open to owner override. No product code changed, so runner, mock-site and offline verifiers were NOT RUN.

history.released_reason: L0 awkit-djnl.2 closed and export refreshed to 302 issues, 290 closed, ready set is the epic plus L1, L2, L4a and L5a
